origin.description: Same q rules as dQuote, with single quotes.

arguments.name: q
arguments.text: TRUE, TeX, UTF-8, a four-string vector, or None for straight quotes.

origin.details: UTF-8 uses U+2018 and U+2019. TeX uses a backtick and an apostrophe. A four-string vector supplies positions 1 and 2.
